notes: The initial Windows run remains a failed run; later focused passes do not change its status.

The Orion trace contains WebGL/THREE context loss and a 15.04-second selector-resolution gap. Its underlying driver/environment/application cause is not proven; the unchanged workflow passes in Linux and all three focused Windows repeats.
The aspect trace has a normal same-coordinate click and hover with no real pointer re-entry; the test-only fix supplies that movement without removing assertions or changing product code.
Browser-reported WebGL renderer strings may be privacy masked and do not establish physical hardware. Separate performance reports identify their actual host and scope.
Historical installed and native/performance reports retain their actual revisions; no prior result is silently relabelled as final.
Actual Safari/macOS, desktop screen reader, reference integrated-GPU laptop, moderated participants and human editorial review remain external acceptance gates.
